Title: Explaining and modelling
Description: New material in small steps, with clear models and thinking aloud.

Title: Questioning the whole room
Description: Every learner responds, so you know who has it and who does not.

Title: Daily review and retrieval
Description: Short, regular recall of earlier learning, so it is not forgotten.

Title: Accessible by design
Description: Slides and documents meet WCAG 2.2 AA before anyone sees them.

Title: An organised Teams space
Description: Learners find material in a few clicks and cannot change it by accident.

Title: Planning and sequencing
Description: Lessons build in a logical order, with checkpoints along the way.

Title: Scaffolds that fade
Description: Support is reduced step by step until learners work independently.

Title: Assistive technology as normal
Description: Read-aloud, dictation and captions are taught to everyone and used openly.

Title: Responsive questioning
Description: Answers change what happens next in the lesson.

Title: Reducing cognitive overload
Description: Clear design and one idea at a time leave room for thinking.

Title: Choice and flexibility
Description: More than one way to take in learning and to show it.

Title: Flipped learning
Description: Learners meet content first; lesson time goes on applying it.

Title: Learner-led enquiry
Description: Learners ask the questions that drive the learning.

Title: Purposeful AI
Description: AI improves resources and saves time, with professional judgement on every output.

Title: Real-world collaborative projects
Description: Learners solve real problems for real audiences, together.
